observation.visible_scene: A dance/aerobics studio with a parquet wood floor and a full-height mirror wall on the left and center; a frosted window and a round wall clock are on the right wall. A man in a black sleeveless top and black pants stands in the foreground with his back to the camera, facing the mirror. His front-facing reflection (black top with a pink-and-yellow logo) appears in the mirror, along with the reflections of several other people standing further back (a person in a teal top and purple pants, a person in a yellow top and shorts, and a person in white at the far left). The camera viewpoint and the room fixtures (clock, window, mirror frame, floor) remain fixed throughout.
visible_changes: The foreground man performs a continuous rhythmic routine driven by his limbs while his torso stays roughly centered in the frame.
He repeatedly lifts one knee off the floor (e.g., frames 5-11, 16-21, 26-31, 36-41) and returns both feet to the floor between lifts (e.g., frames 1-4, 12-15, 22-25, 32-35).
His arms cycle through bent-at-chest positions, outward/sideways extensions, and one arm raised overhead (overhead-arm poses in frames 8-11, 18-21, 28-31, 40-41), matching the knee-lift phases.
The mirror reflection of the man reproduces the same arm and leg movements in sync, confirming the front-facing figure is a reflection rather than a second person.
The reflected background people (teal, yellow, white tops) remain largely stationary with hands near their faces, showing no coordinated movement with the foreground man.
No camera pan, tilt, or zoom is evident; background landmarks hold constant positions across frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the routine began before this excerpt or continues after it; the first and last poses differ and need not connect.
The source of timing/tempo (music, instructor cue) is not visible.
The identities, exact positions, or activity of the real people whose reflections appear in the mirror (they are off-camera).
The full sequence of steps beyond the sampled frames.
uncertain_details: Exact clock reading is hard to confirm (hands near 1:50).
Small shifts in the man's foot placement between cycles are difficult to track precisely due to sampling interval.
It is unclear whether the reflected background figures move slightly; their apparent stillness may be limited by frame resolution.
